text: Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Boards of Management of twelve (12) Business Improvement Areas that fall within the Toronto and East York Community Council boundaries for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Bloorcourt Village: Bekiaris, Toula Cabral, George Caira, Chris Maloney, Roona Yee, Antonia College West: Correia, Matthew Hipolito, Victor Howell, Alexandra Monahan, Paul Dovercourt Village: den Hartog, Elizabeth Jiang, Qin Jun Reis, Elizabeth Savazzi, Frank Soltanzadeh, Nezam Dupont by the Castle: Britto, Nigel Campbell, DJenne Egger, Jesse Harbord Street: Adelaars, Joe Katz, Roslyn Kolomeir, Zachary Oakes, John Wisniewski, Susan Wright, Neil Korea Town: Barbosa, Philip Hunt, Jonathan Lee, Jason Lee, Matthew Lee,…
